answer: By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A beacon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the kernel of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt.
